annotation.title_clean: European Declaration on Digital Rights and Principles for the Digital Decade
annotation.title_en: European Declaration on Digital Rights and Principles for the Digital Decade
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament, Council of the EU and European Commission
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 23/1
annotation.summary_en: Joint solemn declaration by the European Parliament, Council and Commission setting out digital rights and principles: people-centred transformation, solidarity, freedom of choice, safety and privacy, participation, and sustainability. Includes commitments on human-centric, transparent AI with human oversight. Declaratory and non-binding; no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Declaratory commitment to put people at the centre of digital transformation, with offline rights applying online
AI should be human-centric, trustworthy and transparent, with people informed when interacting with AI
Human supervision of algorithmic outcomes affecting safety and fundamental rights
AI use in workplace must be transparent, risk-based, with human oversight of important decisions
Commitments on privacy, cybersecurity for connected products, child protection and sustainable digital products
